t: Claude Opus 5 launch
s: We launched Claude Opus 5, a thoughtful and proactive model that comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price.

t: On Claude Opus 5, disabling thinking is allowed only at effort high or below: thinking: {"type": "disabled"} with effort xhigh or max returns a 400 error, a…
s: On Claude Opus 5, disabling thinking is allowed only at effort high or below: thinking: {"type": "disabled"} with effort xhigh or max returns a 400 error, a breaking change from Claude Opus 4.8.

t: We’ve launched Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5), a step-change improvement over Claude Opus 4.8.

t: The fallbacks parameter now supports a "default" mode, which applies Anthropic’s recommended fallback models by refusal category.
s: Server-side fallback is in beta, and the "default" mode requires the server-side-fallback-2026-07-01 beta header.

t: We’ve removed fast mode for Claude Opus 4.7.
s: Requests to claude-opus-4-7 with speed: "fast" now return an error; unlike Claude Opus 4.6, they do not fall back to standard speed. Claude Opus 4.7 itself remains available at standard speed. To continue using fast…

t: Effort is the primary control for steering Claude Opus 5: the model supports the full ladder (low, medium, high, xhigh, max), with max for capability-critical…
s: Effort is the primary control for steering Claude Opus 5: the model supports the full ladder (low, medium, high, xhigh, max), with max for capability-critical work.

t: Claude Managed Agents session thread event streams now support event deltas.
s: GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/threads/{thread_id}/stream accepts the same event_deltas[] query parameter as the session-level stream, so you can preview a subagent’s text as the model generates it. A connection previews…

t: You can now set an effort level on a Claude Managed Agents agent’s model configuration.
s: Pass effort inside the model object when you create the agent.

t: The version field is now optional when updating a Claude Managed Agents agent.
s: Supply it for optimistic concurrency (a mismatch returns a 409 error), or omit it to apply the update unconditionally.

t: Webhooks for Claude Managed Agents now cover the environment and memory store lifecycle: four environment.* event types and three memory_store.* event types.
s: You can react to environment and memory store lifecycle changes without polling.

t: When creating a Claude Managed Agents session, you can now seed it with initial events.
s: Pass initial_events on POST /v1/sessions with up to 50 user.message and user.define_outcome events. A non-empty list starts the agent loop in the same call, so you don’t need a separate send-events request to start work.

t: Updated memory for Claude
s: Memory on Claude now works as a set of individual, categorized entries that Claude reads and updates during your conversations, replacing the previous daily memory summary.
